one narrative instead of reading as five unrelated documents. Plan is
written and committed; NO manifest or prose edits made yet.

  context dies at its own boundary: border/checkerboard 90/16 hits in 1.1
  and 0 in 1.2-1.5; Growing Dots 17 in 1.2 and 0 elsewhere; bagel 25 in 1.2
  and 0 elsewhere; Sylvia 6 in 1.3 and 0 elsewhere. Four disposable casts,
  none recurring. All five problem sets are 100 percent intra-section.
- ROOT CAUSE 1: no pipeline stage has cross-section scope. layout-place
  assigns sources per heading, section-author welds within one section,
  remaster applies voice within one section. Nobody asks the chapter-level
  question.
- ROOT CAUSE 2 (the big one): book_manifest.yaml files mvp-m1 3.4 The Water
  Park and 3.5 Pooling it Together into Appendix C.6 -- a course cut that is
  never scheduled -- while section 1.4 Domain and Range is assigned ZERO mvp
  sources and was built entirely from OpenStax one-offs. Section 1.3 was
  assigned mvp-m1 3.2/3.3/3.6 and used none of them.
- Verified mvp-m1 has ZERO exponent material (0 hits for product/quotient
  property, zero/negative exponent, scientific notation) vs 202 in alg1 and
  261 in elem-alg. So 1.5 stays a context-free OpenStax outlier by design.
- Verified MVP READY/SET/GO is already a spaced-review device (Module 1 task
  4 READY topic is "use function notation to evaluate equations", four tasks
  before notation is taught). So we do NOT need CPMs copyrighted Review and
  Preview -- MVP ships the same thing CC BY 4.0.

docs/plans/2026-08-29-im1-chapter1-reauthor-source-contract.md (19KB)

STATE: 40/59 = 68% (was 21/59). Run: node web/app/cad/scripting/parity/check-parity.mjs (also in npm test). It checks WIRING only - that each claimed name is exported from global.ts - never equivalence.
  VERIFIED by independent critics driving the real mouse tools: segment, polyline, arc, point, rect, circle; parallel, perpendicular, tangent, angle; revolve (270deg partial, volume+cap+washer areas), loft (cone frustum).
  BUILT BUT NOT YET CRITIC-VERIFIED: ellipse, ellipticalArc, bezier; equalLength, equalRadius, pointOnLine, pointOnArc, pointInMiddle, pointToLineDistance. These have their own checks and sabotage proofs but no independent critic pass.
  sweep() works ONLY with a box path host - it refuses cylinder/cone/torus by design, see below.

NEXT: launch wave 4, three builders on disjoint files -
  (a) expr.ts + compile.ts: CUT, SHELL_TOOL, HOLE_TOOL, PATTERN_LINEAR, PATTERN_RADIAL, MIRROR_BODY
  (b) sketchConstraints.ts: symmetry, mirror, lockConvex
  (c) sketch.ts: sketch fillet, Dim/HDim/VDim
  Lead owns global.ts and manifest.json - builders must never touch either, that is what keeps them from colliding.
  OPEN QUESTION FOR THE OWNER, do not decide alone: SM_FLANGE, SM_TAB, WIRE_LINE, DELETE_BODY, DEFEATURE_REMOVE_FACE may have no sensible scripted form (interactive/sheet-metal). Chasing 59/59 could mean building wrappers nobody would use just to reach 100. Ask before grinding.

WATCH:
  1. TEN defects found, all SILENT - nothing threw, everything produced plausible output. Full record with reproducers: web/app/cad/scripting/parity/KNOWN-DEFECTS.md. READ IT BEFORE TOUCHING THE SOLVER.
  2. Still unfixed, deliberately: (a) AlgNumSystem reports a different DOF and conflict verdict depending on constraint insertion order - parallel-then-perpendicular says conflict:false, the reverse says true; (b) mface.ts calls a revolved cylindrical wall planar, so face.normal()/isPlaneBased LIE for revolve output - verify orientation through STEP + Python OCP instead.
  3. SWEEP places a path loop from a cylinder/cone host at z = host height instead of 0. Volume matched Pappus to 14804.407 EXACTLY while the solid sat a full height off - only a bounding box caught it. expr.ts refuses those hosts rather than compensating; do NOT "fix" it by subtracting the height, that inverts into a bug the day upstream fixes the placement.
  4. Scalar invariants are translation-invariant. Volume, radii, face counts all pass for a correct shape in the wrong place. A stadium prism and a box both have 6 faces and 12 edges. Always assert POSITION too.
  5. Do not let builders run npm run pack - concurrent webpack builds race on dist/. Lead rebuilds once, then critics verify.
